author: GameTrailers
description:
Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars is available now on PICO, Android XR and Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S. Watch the Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars launch trailer for this mixed reality experience that expands Andy Weir’s sci-fi universe in a previously untold chapter. 

Step into the role of Ryland Grace in an original chapter of the Hail Mary mission, with James Ortiz reprising his role as Rocky. Experience humanity’s last hope firsthand as deep space grows increasingly uncertain around them. This mixed-reality experience blends your own physical environment with the Hail Mary itself. Diagnose problems, improvise solutions, and push the limits of science and engineering to keep the mission alive.
title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars - Official Launch Trailer

description:

The free Slaughter Mode update for DOOM: The Dark Ages - Revelations launches on Game Pass, Xbox Series X/S, Steam, Battlenet, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on November 16, 2026.

description:
Meet the Knight (voiced by Troy Baker) and Iris (voiced by Ben Starr) in this trailer for Wonderful Neoran Valley, an upcoming narrative-driven monster collector roguelite game. The new trailer showcases gameplay and the Neoran (in-game creatures) you can find. Wonderful Neoran Valley will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2028.

Wonderful Neoran Valley is set in a vibrant, living world inhabited by creatures known as Neoran - a unique evolution of animal and plant life shaped by a primordial life force known as Neura. Capable of speaking, experiencing complex emotions and pursuing personal goals, Neoran are far more than simple companions: getting to know them is essential both to recruiting them and unlocking their true potential in battle.
title: Wonderful Neoran Valley - Official Welcome to the Valley Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
500 stabs. 20 minutes to escape. Check out the launch trailer for 500 Finger Fillet, a horror roguelite about being handcuffed to a hand-stabbing machine that won't unlock itself until you've stabbed between your fingers – or into them – 500 times. With just 20 minutes on the clock, you’ll need to resort to extreme measures to survive. 

Choose what the machine stabs you with next, from the dull Rusty Fork to the all-seeing Ritual Knife. Earn money through stabbing your hand, which you can spend on items and rings to improve your chances. Each stab carries risk. Each stab brings you closer to freedom. Do you have what it takes to escape?

500 Finger Fillet is available now on PC.
title: 500 Finger Fillet - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Conquer the tower through trial and error. Get a deep dive into the gameplay of Dungeon Automata in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler. Dungeon Automata will be available on PC on January 26, 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.

Dungeon Automata is a new twist to the dungeon crawler genre. It’s an auto battler meets logic-based visual scripting, where you control golems’ behavior through programming. By analyzing enemy actions, optimizing your party members’ blueprints and studying how they support each other, you will conquer the dungeon through trial and error.
title: Dungeon Automata - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Handmancers leaves early access, and version 1.0 is available now on Steam. Watch the Handmancers version 1.0 launch trailer for this first-person Rock-Paper-Scissors roguelite deckbuilder game.

Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beat Paper, Paper beats Rock. In Handmancers, those familiar rules are just the beginning. Take your Signs, enhance them with Gems, and equip powerful Artifacts to turn simple matchups into explosive combinations. Powerful plays come at a cost: going too fast builds up Cramps, limiting your options until you recover. Every battle asks you to balance immediate power against the hand you’ll need next.
title: Handmancers - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
In Sankan, you work the night shift at a gas station on an old mountain road in Yamanashi. Make coffee, stock shelves, mop floors, smoke under the canopy. Serve customers, talk to them, check their cars and their stories. Every shift the voice names one of them. Kill him, and you and your friends have to mop the blood before the next car and bury the body before dawn. The people you met come back in later shifts. So does what you did. Refuse the voice, and the night turns on you: the lights go out and you have to survive until morning. Stay together and pick up the fallen.

No voice acting, everyone talks in subtitles. Several endings. Wishlist Sankan on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131760/SANKAN/
title: Sankan - Official Reveal Trailer
